description: This Java source file defines utility functions for reconstructing (or 'shredding') variant data structures from a shredded format, including an interface for reading shredded rows and methods for rebuilding variants based on schema and data.

classes.name: ShreddingUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to rebuild variant data structures from shredded data according to a specific schema.

classes.name: ShreddedRow
classes.description: Interface for reading data from a shredded row, providing methods to access various data types and nested structures.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Reconstructs a Variant object from a shredded row and schema, intended to be called on top-level data.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Recursively rebuilds a variant value from shredded data into a VariantBuilder, following the specified schema.
